events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place over three days in August 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite slice of Woodstock history?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost the King, Elvis Presley. He would have been 91. What's the one Elvis track that always gets you moving?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On September 13, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot and killed in Las Vegas at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Today marks 30 years since the music world lost an icon, Tupac Shakur. He would have been 55. His legacy continues to inspire – what's your go-to track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away at the age of 27, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago today, we lost the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. He would have been 84. His guitar work still sounds out of this world. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic Album
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous in history – what's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday Celebration
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend whose voice still sounds incredible. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary former Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on this day in 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation and still rock 'n' rolling. What's your favourite Liam moment, Oasis or solo?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Song Impact
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates globally. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod launched
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple launched the device that changed our music habits forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated globally as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the girls, and especially those iconic theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond and what's your top Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music still inspires millions. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese, born on this day in 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Comedy King
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his work is timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles delivered the sprawling masterpiece that is the 'White Album'. Which track from this iconic double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. He would have been 80. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?
